facts.text: The UNH College of Professional Studies Online charges a flat tuition rate of $345 per credit for undergraduate bachelor's degree programs, offering a uniform rate regardless of state of residence.

sources.title: Affordable Tuition | Online
sources.quote: $345 a credit for bachelor's degrees. $640 a credit for graduate degrees* No application fee or admission deposit. We offer a single price, regardless of your state of residence.
